## 1. Master Developer & Township Summary
- **Project Name:** Pride World City
- **Common Search Aliases & Spellings:** Pride World City Pune, Pride World City Charholi, Pride World City Charoli, Pride World City Charohli, Pride City Charholi Budruk, PWC Charholi, Pride Group Charholi Township
- **Developer:** Pride Group (Pride Developers Pune), 28+ years legacy, led by Managing Director Mr. Arvind Jain
- **Location:** Adjacent to D.Y. Patil Knowledge City, Charholi Budruk (commonly spelled Charoli / Charohli, PIN 412105), Alankapuram–Lohegaon–Charholi Corridor, North Pune, Maharashtra, India
- **Geo-Coordinates:** 18.6366° N, 73.8967° E
- **Total Township Acreage:** Approximately 400 contiguous acres
- **Completed Development:** 5+ Million Sq. Ft.
- **Under Construction Footprint:** 8+ Million Sq. Ft.
- **Open & Green Belt Ratio:** 70% open space
- **Township Community:** 10,000+ families (envisioned & residing across delivered clusters)
- **Official Contact:** +91 77440 09295 | WhatsApp: https://wa.me/917744009295 | https://prideworld.city/pride-world-city-vip-site-visit | https://prideworld.city/
- **MahaRERA Official Verification Portal:** https://maharera.mahaonline.gov.in

## 3. Township Social, Civic & Commercial Ecosystem
- **Pride Tech Park:** Dedicated Grade-A commercial IT & corporate office district enabling walk-to-work life in North Pune.
- **Global Indian International School (GIIS Charholi):** Operational Cambridge & CBSE K-12 school inside township gates with priority admission for resident children.
- **Club Royale / Club Charholi:** 50,000 sq. ft. flagship recreational club with Olympic lap pool, heated indoor pool, 4-lane bowling alley, Dolby Atmos screening theater, banquet halls, spa, gym, and sunset lounge.
- **7-Acre Central Natural Lake:** Authentic freshwater lake with 1.2 km boardwalk, musical fountains, and landscaped promenade.
- **10-Acre Multi-Sport Arena:** Full cricket turf, FIFA-grade football pitch, tennis, badminton, and pickleball courts.
- **Planned & Upcoming Infrastructure:** 100-bed multispeciality hospital zone, Town Plaza high-street shopping & multiplex, 5-star business hotel, senior citizen living zone, and operational BRTS rapid transit bus hub.

## 4. Pune Real Estate Market Benchmark & Micro-Market Commute Distances
- **Detailed Guide URL:** https://prideworld.city/charholi-pune-real-estate

### Distances from Pride World City
- **D.Y. Patil Knowledge City:** 0.5 km (2 mins, adjacent)
- **PMRDA 128-km Pune Ring Road Interchange:** 1.8 km (3 mins)
- **Dhanori & Lohegaon Suburbs:** 3.5 km (7 mins)
- **Pune International Airport (PNQ):** 4.8 km (10 mins) via Dhanori-Lohegaon Airport Road
- **Viman Nagar & Phoenix Marketcity:** 8.5 km (14 mins)
- **Kharadi IT Park, EON Free Zone & World Trade Center:** 11.0 - 11.5 km (18 - 20 mins via 8-lane link corridor)
- **Bhosari MIDC & Chakan Industrial Corridor:** 12.0 km (20 mins)
- **Kalyani Nagar & Koregaon Park:** 12.5 km (22 mins)

### Comparative Market Index (₹/sq.ft & Annual Rental Yield)
- **Charholi Budruk (Pride World City):** ₹6,800 - ₹8,200 / sq.ft | **4.8% - 6.0%** yield | 42.8% 5-yr historical appreciation
- **Dhanori & Lohegaon:** ₹6,200 - ₹7,800 / sq.ft | 3.8% - 4.5% yield
- **Viman Nagar:** ₹11,500 - ₹16,500 / sq.ft | 3.2% - 3.8% yield
- **Kharadi (EON / WTC):** ₹8,900 - ₹13,200 / sq.ft | 3.5% - 4.2% yield
- **Hinjawadi IT Park:** ₹6,800 - ₹9,500 / sq.ft | 3.6% - 4.4% yield (60+ mins from Airport)
- **Baner & Balewadi:** ₹9,800 - ₹14,500 / sq.ft | 3.1% - 3.7% yield
- **Wagholi (Nagar Road):** ₹5,400 - ₹7,100 / sq.ft | 3.5% - 4.1% yield
- **Moshi & Alandi:** ₹5,200 - ₹6,600 / sq.ft | 3.4% - 4.0% yield

## 9. Balanced Buyer Reviews, Strengths & Due Diligence Audit (2026)
- **Audit URL:** https://prideworld.city/pride-world-city-reviews-owner-feedback
- **Verified Resident Strengths:** 5M+ sq.ft delivered across Kingsbury, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Notting Hill & Long Island; operational GIIS Cambridge & CBSE K-12 campus inside township gates; internal 7-acre freshwater lake, rainwater harvesting & STP dual-plumbing minimizing tanker dependency; 4.8%–6.0% annual gross rental yield driven by Kharadi IT, Airport, D.Y. Patil & PCMC tenants.
- **Buyer Checklist & Honest Trade-Offs:** Distinguish OC-ready clusters (0% GST in Kingsbury/Brooklyn/Manhattan) from active construction towers (`maharera.mahaonline.gov.in`); verify external village approach road widening along Charholi–Lohegaon during peak hours; inspect acoustic glazing options (e.g. Montreal / Valencia) given proximity (4.8 km) to Pune Airport / Lohegaon air operations.
